svg.title: The scan cycle against the stepping cadence
svg.desc: Two timelines for scans s001 and s002 with zero start and scan offsets, on one time axis ticked in scan periods. At the scan period, every step starts on a scan time and delivers a frame, and the scan index alternates 0, 1, 0, 1. At twice the rate, only every other step starts on a scan time; the steps in between fire no scan, publish no radar frame and leave the pending scan unchanged, so the published frames still alternate s001 and s002.
svg.text: every step starts on a scan time and delivers a frame
only firings advance the scan; the steps between scan times leave it unchanged, so the published frames still alternate s001 and s002
time in scan periods T, the reciprocal of the frame rate; a scan is scheduled at every multiple of T
